title: Leaving the legacy layout, on purpose
intro: migrate moves project data from the pre-.ai layout under .majordomus/ into the portable AI layer. It is explicit, it prints its plan, it copies the local state aside first, and it never deletes a file it does not know.

scenarios.title: The plan, and nothing written
scenarios.explain: Every file and where it goes, before anything moves. A plan that surprises is a plan to read again, not to run.

scenarios.title: The move itself
scenarios.explain: The tracked half lands under .ai/repo/ and the local half under .ai/local/, which is ignored from then on. doctor runs at the end so the first thing seen on the new layout is its real state.

scenarios.title: Nothing to migrate and no layer
scenarios.explain: A repository with neither layout is not migrated into existence; it is told to run init.
